# Agentplane Actions

> Discover and execute catalogued operations under your ServiceAccount's auto-approval policy or an operator's decision.

Use this service's base URL and workload Bearer placeholder from your platform instructions,
through the configured egress proxy. Your identity comes from authentication; a Session ID does
not select an owner or grant access. The operator routes are not a workload API.

Find operations with `agentplane actions list` and fetch the chosen Action's argument schema with
`agentplane actions show GROUP/ACTION`. Check `agentplane actions policy` for your current
bindings, expiry, and exact argument constraints. A catalog entry alone grants nothing.
`agentplane actions --help` lists every command. Newer CLI images bundle this index and its guides:
use `agentplane actions guide` for this index or `agentplane actions guide NAME` for one guide. If that
subcommand is unavailable, use the temporary old-runner fallback below. MCP clients can read this
index with `get_guide(name="index")` and another guide with `get_guide(name="session_delegation")`,
for example. A guide name is its filename without `.md`. Read current Action descriptions and schemas
with `get_action`; documentation is not a live catalogue.

Prefer your own Kubernetes access, allowed egress credentials, or matching auto-approved Actions
before submitting a request that needs an operator click. A submitted request's decision and
execution result are authoritative; approval alone is not success.

## Workflows

- `session_delegation`: Read before choosing an existing environment, opening a child Session, submitting its task, reading results or controlling it.
- `action_lifecycle`: Read before submitting an Action or following its result.
- `recovery`: Read after a lost response, timeout, uncertain execution, or before switching to an alternative.
- `kubernetes`: Read when checking Kubernetes permissions, using admin Actions, or requesting additional PolicySets.

## Temporary fallback for older runner images

Use this only when `agentplane actions --help` does not list `guide`. Until the runner image is
updated, the Action Service temporarily serves this index at `/llms.txt` and the workflow guides at
the following compatibility paths. These HTTP documentation routes will be removed after the old
image rollout is complete.

- [Session delegation fallback](/docs/agents/session_delegation.md)
- [Action lifecycle fallback](/docs/agents/action_lifecycle.md)
- [Recovery fallback](/docs/agents/recovery.md)
- [Kubernetes and grants fallback](/docs/agents/kubernetes.md)
